Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 5, Verse 18

“The wise see the same in a brahmana endowed with learning and humility, in a cow, in an elephant, and in a dog or an outcaste.”

One of the boldest verses in the Gita, and the list is deliberately provocative. Krishna runs from the most honoured to the most despised and refuses to let the seeing change.
